verdict.rationale: Self-hosting an email app and controlling the mail pipeline is a fair question for an email client, so the axis applies. The evidence pack only documents Microsoft Graph and Exchange Online APIs for working with mail; nothing shows Outlook can be self-hosted or the pipeline run on user-controlled infrastructure. Users switching to Thunderbird are a workaround, not an Outlook capability.

support.subject: As a switcher, I can self-host the email app and keep the mail pipeline under my own control
